newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in March-EMCO.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in March-EMCO.

text.p: Average wholesale New Zealand electricity prices in March rose in the North and South Islands compared with February prices, electricity market operator EMCO said on Wednesday.
The average wholesale electricity price for the South Island (at the Benmore reference point) in March was 4.81 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 4.60 cents in February.
The average wholesale electricity price in the North Island (at the Haywards reference point) in March was 5.08 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 4.96 cents in February.
EMCO said South Island hydro lake storage levels continued to be worth watching.
"Lake levels have been below average, although they are currently significantly above 1992 levels for the same time of the year," EMCO said.
"Storage levels are obviously not the only factor in the price but there is a close correlation."
